translation.name: Lagano da Sambi kwa Wanhu Wose

book.name: Matayo
book.title: Mbuli Inogile ya Yesu Kilisito yandikigwe na Matayo

content: Yesu komuhonya munhu yeli na dikulu
Yesu viyahumuluke kulawa kukigongo lunhu lwa wanhu lumkweleleza.
Munhu imoja yeli na utamu wa dikulu kamgendela Yesu, kamfugamila kalonga, “Go mkulu, wahalonda kodaha kunihonya.”
Yesu kamgolosela mkono wake, kamkwasa munhu ayo kalonga, “Nolonda, hona!” Bahaja munhu ayo kahona.

Abaho Yesu kamulongela, “Tegeleza! Sekeumulongele munhu yoyose, lakini goga inzila mbaka kwa mulava nhosa yakakulolese lolese. Abaho kalave nhosa kamba viyalagize Musa ili kutenda kila munhu yatogole kamba kuhonyigwa.”
Yesu komuhonya msang'hanaji wa mkulu wa wakalizi wa Lumi
Yesu viyengile Kapelinaumu, mkulu imoja wa wakalizi wa Lumi kamgendela kampula yamtaze.
Kalonga, “Go mkulu, msang'hanaji wangu kawasa ukae, kaholola na kolumwa ng'hani.”
Yesu kamulongela, “Nochola kumuhonya.”
Mkulu ayo kamwidika, “Go mkulu niye sifaya gweye wingile mng'anda yangu. Lakini longa mbuli na msang'hanaji wangu kohona.

Naniye vivija na hasi ya udahi wa wakulu na nina wakalizi hasi yangu. Nahamulongela ino ‘Chola!’ nayo kochola, nahamulongela iyagwe ‘Izo!’ nayo kokwiza, vivija nahamulongela msang'hanaji wangu, ‘Tenda vino!’ nayo kotenda vivo.”
Yesu viyahulike avo, kakanganya kawalongela waja wamkweleleza, “Nowalongeleni, sinamona munhu yoyose mwiisi ya Izilaeli yotamanila kamba ino.
Nowalongeleni ukweli, wanhu wengi wokwiza kulawa mwambu wa kudilawila zuwa na mwambu wa kudihongela, wokala hamoja na Abulahamu na Isaka na Yakobo mna ulujo kuna Uundewa wa kuulanga.
Lakini waja wolondeka wawe muundewa wa Mulungu wokwasigwa kunze kudiziza, ako wolila na kudafuna meno.”
Abaho Yesu kamulongela mkulu ayo, “Chola ukae, na kija chuupulile chotendigwa.” Saa iija msang'hanaji wake kahona.
Yesu kowahonya wanhu wengi
Yesu viyacholile ukayake Petulo, kamvika mkwe wa kitwanzi wa Petulo kawasa mulusazi, kolumwa homa.
Yesu kamgoga mkono wake na homa imulawa, nayo kenuka kasonga kuwasang'hanila.
Ichungulo viivikile, wanhu wamgalila Yesu wanhu wengi wakalile na vinyamkela. Yesu kawalava vinyamkela kwa kulonga na kawahonya wakalile watamu.
Katenda avo muladi kilawilile kija kiyalongile mtula ndagu wa Mulungu Isaya, “Heyo mwenyego kasola magayo getu na kapapa mitamu yetu.”
Wanahina wa Yesu viwolondeka kukala
Yesu viyaluwone lunhu lwa wanhu lumzunguluka, kawalagiza wanahina zake waloke mwambu uyagwe wa lamba.
Mfundiza Malagizo ga Musa imoja kamcholela kamulongela, “Mfundiza, nokuwinza kokose kuuchola.”
Yesu kamwidika, “Vizongo wana mhango na ndege wana mvulu, lakini Mwana wa Munhu kaduhu hanhu ha kubwihila.”
Mwanahina wake imoja kamulongela, “Go mkulu, beta tanhu mbweleganye hamzike tatangu.”
Lakini Yesu kamulongela, “Nikweleleze, waleke wanhu wafile wawazike wanhu wao wafile.”
Yesu kohoza beho
Yesu kengila mwiingalawa na wanahina zake wamkweleleza.
Bahaja dilawilila beho kulu kudilamba, na mawimbi ga mazi gaitowa ingalawa, mbaka ingalawa ilonda kudidimila. Lakini Yesu kakala yawasile.
Wanahina zake wamgendela wamulamusa, wamulongela “Go mkulu, tukombole todidimila!”
Yesu kawalongela, “Mweye mutamanila kidogo, habali modumba?” Avo kenuka kadikomhokela beho na ng'humbi ya mazi vinyamale na baho kukala tuluu.
Wanhu wakanganya, wauza, “Vino ino munhu gani? Mbaka beho na ng'humbi vomuhulika!”
Yesu kowahonya wanhu wabili weli na vinyamkela
Yesu viyavikile umwambu, mwiisi ya Gadala, kaiting'hana na wanhu wabili weli na vinyamkela, walawa kuna gamapanga. Wanhu awo wakala wodumbigwa, avo kuduhu munhu yadahile kubita nzila ayo.
Bahaja viwamone Yesu waguta mizangi wolonga, “Gweye Mwana wa Mulungu, kotulonda choni? Kwiza kutudununza kipindi king'hali hakinavika?”
Behi na hanhu aho hakala na bumbila da nguluwe woja.
Avo vinyamkela wampula Yesu, “Wahatulava tuleke twingile mna iwanguluwe.”
Yesu kawalongela, “Choleni,” Avo walawa na wengila mna iwanguluwe. Bumbila jose dihumulukila mna ingema ya dilamba na wose wafa mgamazi.
Wasusilaji wa nguluwe awo wakimbila, wachola kudibuga, ako walonga mbuli zose zilawilile na walonga mbuli ya wanhu waja wakalile na vinyamkela.
Avo wanhu wose walawa kudibuga dija, wachola kuiting'hana na Yesu. Na viwamone wampula yasegele mwiisi yao.
